gen-almendra-display-gf-radio-canada: Ornate lettering with a literary air sets Almendra Display apart up top. And Radio Canada follows in a plain sans, tall and full in its lowercase, with one unvarying line.
gen-audiowide-gf-radio-canada-big: Audiowide's letters sit apart like tiles with wide grout lines, all with the same stroke thickness. And Radio Canada Big, a monoline sans with open terminals, would feel out of place if the heading shrank.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Dark and aggressive, Eater looks it. Noto Sans Nushu is a different animal, with a towering x-height and terminals held far from the stroke, so long stretches of it read clear and open.
gen-fs-bonny-plus-jakarta-sans: Bonny brings a literary, refined voice, its thin strokes never turning spindly. Plus Jakarta Sans meets it with a modern, precise sans, curves drawn like thread, so the two sit together as old study and new desk.
gen-almendra-display-gf-readex-pro: Readex Pro reads as a sans with broad gaps at its terminals and a steady weight from word to word. Almendra Display does ornate, literary drama best, while Readex handles everything quieter.
gen-audiowide-gf-roboto: Roboto reads clean and contemporary, its round letters generous in the mouth and its caps close to body height. And Audiowide's pen-rounded, futuristic letters give the page a bold headline voice that Roboto then calmly carries on.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Noto Sans Ogham reads clean, with tall bodies and wide gaps in the e. Eater is the one for dark, aggressive headlines, its strokes varying only slightly, while the sans-serif body does the quiet, tidy work beneath.
gen-almendra-display-gf-saira: Ornate, literary, a little theatrical. Almendra Display brings that drama, and Saira, a plain sans with see-through s shapes and rounded letters reaching high, gives it a clean counterweight.
gen-audiowide-gf-ruda: Audiowide's glyphs sit like tiles with wide grout lines, giving it a futuristic, tech feel. Ruda keeps the sans-serif side approachable and clean.
gen-almendra-display-gf-sofia-sans: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display opens the pair with letters that never pinch shut. Sofia Sans, a plain sans with no thick-and-thin modulation, makes the strongest contrast: modern lowercase like cut acrylic pieces.
